objective: Make enemy AI less predictable, smarter and more realistic, with rapid simulation, observation and tuning tools.
requirements: Seeded individual crews and merchant/escort tactical variation
Limited, noisy sensor observations, uncertainty and no hidden-position/depth targeting
Coordinated convoy screening, delayed shared contacts, complementary search/attack roles
Varied search patterns, committed attack runs, recovery and credible torpedo evasion
Collision/coast avoidance and return to convoy when appropriate
Persist RNG, contact and tactical state across saves
In-game isolated AI lab with scenarios, pause/step/fast-forward/replay and live tuning
Tactical plots, tracks/uncertainty/sensors/intent/reason telemetry and trace export/import
Headless seeded scenario runner and comparative batch metrics
Fairness, reproducibility, variation, coordination, safety and performance regression checks
Preserve tutorial and existing gameplay; rebuild offline standalone HTML
baseline: Identical circular search and fixed-period sinusoidal merchant evasion
Perfect location and depth inside an instantaneous sensor radius
No escort role coordination, contact-sharing delay or attack-run geometry
limitations: Arcade sensor/weapon model informed by 1944 manuals; no exact acoustic or 1942 equipment simulation
Detection duration and clearance metrics sample at 1 Hz
Chrome rendering verification uses Linux SwiftShader; native Windows hardware frame time is unverified
